verdicts.reason: A keeps the dark brand panel, but the sun icon and SOLSTICE wordmark are jammed against its edges and the panel looks cropped. The eyebrow is stranded under the panel, 'Ships late June' is squeezed into a three-line sliver, and the legal text is microscopic, roughly as prominent as the body. B drops the dark band, so the white SOLSTICE logo sits nearly invisible on cream, which is a brand failure. B also cuts the 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' eyebrow loose to the far right, away from the headline it introduces, and the CTA is small and crammed under the body copy next to tiny legal text.
